distribution.instruction: Weigh the feed, film it being given out, and film the water being given out. Any operator on the park may record any capture; the pen is submitted once every compulsory capture is in.

proofs.title: Feed weight photo
proofs.hint: The weighed feed on the scale, reading visible, before it is given out.

proofs.title: Feed distribution video
proofs.hint: Feed actually being given to the animals in this pen.

proofs.title: Water distribution video
proofs.hint: Water being given to the animals in this pen.

wastage.instruction: Film the leftover feed in the pen before it is cleared.

proofs.title: Leftover feed video
proofs.hint: The leftover feed in the trough before it is cleared; the verifier reads the weight off the clip.
